items.headline: US Envoys Meet Putin in Moscow for Peace Talks as Both Sides Pause Strikes on Capitals
items.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Saturday to present a new proposal aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. The high-stakes diplomatic visit prompted both Russia and Ukraine to temporarily halt airstrikes against each other's capitals as negotiators prepare to visit Kyiv next.

items.headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra Featuring Autonomous Digital Capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI has officially launched its newest flagship AI model, GPT-6 Astra, which introduces advanced capabilities for autonomous computer use and multi-step problem solving. The debut is drawing widespread attention because Astra is the company's first model to cross its critical cybersecurity risk threshold, triggering strict safety protocols and controlled rollout tiers.

items.headline: Zheng Qinwen Stuns Madison Keys in Dramatic US Open Comeback
items.summary: Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen mounted a dramatic comeback at the US Open on Saturday, saving a match point when trailing 5-1 in the final set to defeat Madison Keys 1-6, 7-6 (3), 7-5. Her seven-game winning streak to end the match moved her into the tournament's round of 16.

items.headline: Robert Pattinson's Drama 'Primetime' Premieres at Venice Film Festival
items.summary: The dark thriller 'Primetime', starring Robert Pattinson, made its world premiere in competition at the 83rd Venice Film Festival on September 5, 2026. Directed by Lance Oppenheim, the film dramatizes the controversy surrounding mid-2000s reality television and has quickly generated major festival buzz.
